pages.text: Pour every fluid of this mod - and water and lava - into the $(item)Pleroma Confluence$(): $(thing)1,000,000 mB$() of each. Every other mod installed counts too, through its $(fluid)Essence$() (distilled in the $(item)Essence Distillery$()): $(thing)64,000 mB$() of each mod's Essence. The Confluence keeps a running total; when every one is full, 1,000 mB of $(fluid)Pleroma$() appears.

The old word means 'fullness': the totality of everything. Fitting. It accepts fluids from any pipe or AE2 on any side, and Pleroma can be drained from any side. Its screen (and JEI) shows what is still missing.$(br2)Mine is fed by every tank I own.
Pleroma carried in a $(item)Containment Cell$(), like every fluid of the mod: fill it at a tank, empty it into one.
